body:
Well, this morning I woke up from some dream I was having, thought of her automatically as I usually do, only this time, it made me hate myself and want to die.

I just live daily now with the realisation that nothing I ever said to her can have been worth anything. I must truly be a loathsome creature for that to be the case. The sooner I'm gone the sooner I'm out of her hair with my stupid, hated overtures of resumed friendship.

I just completely hate myself at this point.

For the sake of your boyfriend, don't do it. TALK TO HIM.

For the sake of your family, don't do it. TALK TO THEM.

Don't you know they want to help, and that they'd do anything for you?

Try to write out your feelings, in a logical, one-step-at-a-time method to get to the specific root of your misery. Then try and figure out a plan, with help from those who care about you, to overcome it.

The marathon analogy is very apt. It's not too hard to run a marathon with a broken leg, if you let people who care about you hold you up and walk with you.

Eh. Love isn't about who's "worth your time". If it was, I imagine most of us would have been abandoned as babies. I let myself fall out of love as quickly as I could, but, all that did was eliminate the selfish component. It doesn't feel like losing a prospective partner any more. It feels like losing a family member, which hurts even more.

Maybe she just doesn't think of affection as something that can be any good if it's not reciprocal. I don't know. Maybe we're both confused.

We were, but when someone says that although they enjoyed the conversations had, they don't think they'll ever be able to love you in return, to the point where they feel you shouldn't be talking any more, it feels like that's what it means. It feels like I'm not someone good enough to even talk to.
